items.text: Pika opened four generative-audio models through its API Club, emphasizing efficient inference and lower-cost access to frontier-quality audio.
items.text_zh: Pika 通过 API Club 开放四款生成式音频模型，主打高效推理，并以更低成本提供前沿级音频生成能力。

items.text: Anthropic said it is implementing Claude text watermarking for EU AI Act compliance and published an FAQ addressing detection and reliability questions.
items.text_zh: Anthropic 表示将为 Claude 文本加入水印以遵守欧盟《人工智能法案》，并发布常见问题说明检测方式与可靠性。

items.text: Streamlit 1.61 added lazy dataframe loading, background cache refresh and icons for metric components.
items.text_zh: Streamlit 1.61 新增数据表惰性加载、后台缓存刷新，以及指标组件图标。

items.text: Qdrant and Minima demonstrated single-GPU agentic RAG where hybrid search and reranking made the first retrieval sufficient 87% of the time.
items.text_zh: Qdrant 与 Minima 展示了单 GPU 智能体式 RAG；混合搜索和重排使首次检索在 87% 的情况下已足够。

items.text: Nvidia introduced NeMo Switchyard, an open-source routing library that assigns different agent-workflow steps to models based on capability and cost.
items.text_zh: 英伟达推出开源路由库 NeMo Switchyard，可根据能力和成本，为智能体工作流的不同步骤分配模型。

items.text: An Epoch AI–Ipsos survey found most American workplace AI use relies on free plans, except in science and technology occupations.
items.text_zh: Epoch AI 与益普索的调查发现，美国职场中的 AI 使用大多依赖免费方案，科学和技术岗位除外。

items.text: Character.AI added one-click bulk Lorebook imports, letting creators draft fictional-world context externally and bring it into the platform at once.
items.text_zh: Character.AI 新增 Lorebook 一键批量导入，创作者可在外部编写世界观资料，再一次性导入平台。

items.text: Databricks added AI Spend Controls to Unity AI Gateway to catch costs caused by retry loops and uncontrolled agent experiments.
items.text_zh: Databricks 为 Unity AI Gateway 加入 AI 支出控制，用于及时发现重试循环和失控智能体实验造成的费用。

items.text: Goodfire said its Silico research agent autonomously trained a multimodal encoder overnight, then investigated why its vision-language representations underperformed.
items.text_zh: Goodfire 表示，其研究智能体 Silico 在一夜间自主训练出多模态编码器，并进一步调查视觉—语言表征表现不足的原因。

items.text: Google detailed a homomorphic-encryption approach intended to make private AI inference practical while keeping processed data encrypted.
items.text_zh: 谷歌介绍了一种同态加密方案，目标是在处理数据始终保持加密的同时，让隐私 AI 推理变得实用。

items.text: AWS added custom reward functions for multi-turn reinforcement learning with Amazon Nova Forge, enabling developers to tailor model-training objectives.
items.text_zh: AWS 为 Amazon Nova Forge 的多轮强化学习加入自定义奖励函数，让开发者能够按需求调整模型训练目标。

items.text: Tripo updated Image Gen with 3D-ready templates, asset extraction, cutouts and reference-based variants for building consistent asset collections.
items.text_zh: Tripo 更新 Image Gen，加入面向 3D 的模板、资产提取、抠图和参考图变体功能，可制作风格一致的资产集合。

items.text: Krea temporarily made Slack generations unlimited for business customers through August 21, removing rate limits and long generation queues.
items.text_zh: Krea 在 8 月 21 日前为企业客户临时开放 Slack 无限生成，取消调用次数限制和长时间生成队列。

items.text: Dreamina launched Seedance 2.5 video generation at 1080p on its global web product.
items.text_zh: Dreamina 在其全球网页版上线 Seedance 2.5 的 1080p 视频生成功能。

items.text: Nvidia may guarantee up to 25% residual value for selected AI-compute investments, seeking to reassure buyers about hardware depreciation risks.
items.text_zh: 英伟达拟为部分 AI 算力投资提供最高 25% 的残值保障，以缓解买家对硬件贬值风险的担忧。

items.text: MiniMax showcased commercial and music-video projects already being created with its H3 video model at the Magnific event in San Francisco.
items.text_zh: MiniMax 在旧金山 Magnific 活动上展示了创作者已使用 H3 视频模型制作的商业项目和音乐视频。

items.text: A plaintiff embedded invisible AI instructions in court filings, exposing prompt-injection risks for legal systems using automated document review.
items.text_zh: 一名原告在法庭文件中嵌入不可见的 AI 指令，暴露了法律机构采用自动文档审查时的提示词注入风险。

items.text: World Labs introduced a method that converts one demonstrated real-world robot task into thousands of simulated training variations.
items.text_zh: World Labs 提出一种方法，可将一次真实世界机器人任务演示转化为数千个模拟训练变体。

items.text: Zhizhi Research Institute proposed an interpretability method that decomposes model weights while requiring less than 1% of the usual data cost.
items.text_zh: 至知研究院提出一种拆解模型权重的可解释性方法，所需数据成本不足常规方案的 1%。

items.text: A Chinese music-generation model targeted a recurring AI-music quality problem while positioning itself as a domestic challenger to Suno.
items.text_zh: 一款中国音乐生成模型瞄准 AI 音乐长期存在的质量通病，并将自身定位为 Suno 的本土挑战者。

items.text: Runway added 1080p Seedance 2.5 video generation in early access, promising sharper detail at the higher resolution.
items.text_zh: Runway 以抢先体验形式上线 1080p Seedance 2.5 视频生成，主打更高分辨率下的清晰细节。

items.text: Ollama fully deployed DeepSeek-V4-Pro 0813 to its cloud, making the model available through Pro and Max subscriptions.
items.text_zh: Ollama 已在云端全面部署 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 0813，并向 Pro 和 Max 订阅用户开放。

items.text: A new visual-perception benchmark found that leading AI models still perform poorly on basic tasks involving fine visual distinctions and spatial relationships.
items.text_zh: 一项新的视觉感知基准发现，领先 AI 模型在细微视觉区分和空间关系等基础任务上依然表现不佳。

items.text: Researchers described a “tragedy of the cognitive commons,” where individually rational AI adoption could collectively erode professions’ accumulated expertise.
items.text_zh: 研究人员提出“认知公地悲剧”：个体看来合理的 AI 采用行为，可能共同侵蚀整个行业长期积累的专业能力。

items.text: Together AI reported DeepSeek-V4 Pro 0813 reaching 88.5% pass@4 on software-engineering tasks in its DeepSWE evaluation.
items.text_zh: Together AI 报告称，DeepSeek-V4 Pro 0813 在其 DeepSWE 软件工程评测中取得了 88.5% 的 pass@4。

items.text: Artificial Analysis said DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813’s cost per task rose from $0.05 to $0.25 despite improved token efficiency.
items.text_zh: Artificial Analysis 表示，尽管令牌效率有所提升，DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 的单任务成本仍从 0.05 美元升至 0.25 美元。

items.text: Tri Dao argued that open models now trail closed laboratories by only months in quality while open-source serving systems advance rapidly.
items.text_zh: Tri Dao 表示，开放模型的质量如今仅落后闭源实验室数月，同时开源推理服务系统也在快速进步。

items.text: Replit upgraded its MCP integration so external agents can find and update existing Replit projects without requiring an API key.
items.text_zh: Replit 升级了 MCP 集成，使外部智能体无需 API 密钥即可查找并更新现有 Replit 项目。
